exposure: hospital/maternity being located in a capital city
mother's age greater than or equal to 35 years
cohort: Live births from the Nascer no Brasil survey, carried out between 2011 and 2012.
finding: Neonatal near miss was associated with maternal age greater than or equal to 35 years, cesarean delivery, smoking, gestational hypertensive syndrome, pre-gestational diabetes, twin pregnancy, inadequate prenatal care, and the hospital/maternity being located in a capital city.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal near miss.
